label: ML / engineering
source: Our own list for ML and engineering papers; no external checklist is copied

items.text: Says where the data came from and under what licence or access.
Gives the number of examples, classes and features in each dataset.
Explains how the data were split into training, validation and test sets.
Describes every preprocessing and cleaning step applied to the data.
Shows that test data was kept out of training, including any feature or time leakage checks.
Describes the model or algorithm in enough detail to reimplement it.
Lists the hyperparameters and how they were chosen.
Describes the training setup, including the optimiser, schedule and stopping rule.
Defines each evaluation metric and why it suits the task.
Names the baselines compared against, tuned with the same effort as the method.
States how many runs were done and how the reported numbers were aggregated.
Reports the spread across runs, such as standard deviations or confidence intervals.
Reports ablations that isolate the contribution of each component.
Lists the random seeds used for data splits and training.
Lists the software versions, libraries and hardware used.
Says where the code, data and trained models can be obtained.
Says which settings, datasets or tasks the results do not cover.
Describes the cases where the method fails or performs worse.
